headline: Lawon Reveals THAI Board Is Notifying Market of Resolution to Remove “Chai Eamsiri” This Evening
summary: The THAI board is notifying the market of a resolution to remove Chai Eamsiri from the CEO position, with a report to be submitted to the Stock Exchange of Thailand.
why: CEO changes at Stock Exchange of Thailand listed companies are disclosed to the market because leadership shapes strategy, governance and investor confidence.
